Prices for the stay of Nov 7 to 9, 2026, as listed on October 3, 2026.

17 London hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. Prices on this page are per night, all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees; the study's count below uses the before-tax prices of its CSV. The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price).

One snapshot on October 3, 2026 for Nov 7 to Nov 9, 2 adults, US market, USD. Prices change daily.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for London hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the October 3, 2026 snapshot, at 16 of the 17 London hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 6, klook at 3, trivago DEALS at 2, Billabook.com at 1, Booking.com at 1, Kiwi.com at 1, Traveluro at 1 and Vio.com at 1. These are the London rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 16 of the 17 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Taxes and fees at London hotels

At the 12 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 20% ($49 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 19% at The Tower Hotel, by Thistle to 20% at Royal London Hotel. At 5 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
